name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer roles at the City Library for teens, such as helping at programs. Spots are limited and first come, first served.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 8 to 12. Volunteers who work with the public must pass a criminal background check.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 registration is closed. Registration for January 2027 opportunities opens Dec 17 at 5 p.m.
how_to_apply: Fill in the teen volunteer form on the library page when it opens.
notes: Questions: 604-998-3450. The Dec 17 date comes from the Teens' community hub page. Exact roles are not listed on the page read.
